purpose: Define AccessCore authorization as explicit resource/operation rights evaluated independently from IAM assurance and semantic ownership.

topics.name: AccessCore Authorization
topics.purpose: Define AccessCore authorization as explicit resource/operation rights evaluated independently from IAM assurance and semantic ownership.

semantics.off_rule: When AC is off, AC restrictions do not apply.
semantics.on_rule: When AC is on, governed resources/operations require explicit authorization.
semantics.group_rule: system-group has rw by explicit policy; other groups require explicit r/w or operation rights.
semantics.command_rule: Command rights are explicit and separate from data/resource rights.
semantics.assurance_rule: AC policy may additionally require minimum IAM assurance.
semantics.ownership_rule: Semantic ownership does not automatically grant AC authorization.
semantics.ui_rule: Terminal and web/editor surfaces are governed by the same canonical authorization semantics; UI visibility does not bypass AC.

invariants.rule: Identity assurance, authorization, remote delegation and activation state remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: AC authorization inferred from semantic ownership
command right inferred from unrelated resource right
AC-on governed resource accessed without explicit allow
AC-off state treated as implicit permanent authorization record

references.purpose: Assurance may constrain authorization but does not replace it.
Command rights apply to canonical command identities.
